events.event: Standalone gross revenue ₹55,002 crore and PAT ₹10,201 crore establish the ten-year comparison base.
events.significance: Over FY17-FY26, standalone PAT approximately doubled despite portfolio changes.

events.event: ITC's newer digital-first and organic portfolio continued scaling through brands such as Yoga Bar, Mother Sparsh and others.
events.significance: Tests whether diversification can produce attractive incremental returns, not merely revenue.

events.event: Hotels business was demerged; ITC retained a 39.85% associate interest.
events.significance: FY25 total PAT contains a large discontinued-operation gain and is not comparable with FY26 total PAT.
events.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, financial statements and notes

events.event: Cigarette taxation increased materially, including a shift to 40% GST on retail price and higher excise burden.
events.significance: The most important new variable for legal-industry volume, pricing and margin in FY27.
events.source: ITC Report and Accounts 2026, pp.69-73; ITC FY26 results statement

events.event: Continuing revenue reached ₹89,913 crore, continuing PAT ₹21,018 crore and CFO ₹18,464 crore.
events.significance: Revenue outgrew profit and CFO; inventory absorption qualified cash conversion.

events.event: FMCG-Others revenue grew 10.5% and segment result 13.9%, while cigarettes still supplied about 82% of segment result.
events.significance: Diversification is progressing but has not yet changed the group's core profit engine.

events.event: Review FY27 predictions and post-tax cigarette performance.
events.significance: First decisive test of the new tax regime, inventory normalisation and FMCG margin trajectory.
